# Numerical simulation of the dynamics of root systems

## Context
Development done at CIRAD (UMR AMAP). Modelling of root growth dynamics in 2D by solving a time-dependant advection-reaction-diffusion equation. 

## Methods
- Operator splitting 
- Discontinuous finite elements 
- Estimation of parameters with the Levenberg-Marquardt's algorithm 
- Inversion of the finite element matrix with the library MUMPS
- Numerical study of the positivity preserving of the schema

## Stack
Fortran 90 - MUMPS - Make - ParaView (sorties VTK) - Institutional GitLab


## Publication
Peynaud E. 2018. Operator splitting and discontinuous Galerkin methods
for advection-reaction-diffusion problem: application to plant root growth.
Biomath, 7(2). [https://doi.org/10.11145/j.biomath.2018.12.037](https://doi.org/10.11145/j.biomath.2018.12.037)
